content: Nutraments is a nutritional vitamin drink that is currently supplied by Novartis Labs. Originally, it was distributed by Mead Johnson & Company starting in 1960. The product is available in various flavors, including vanilla, chocolate, strawberry, coconut, banana, cappuccino, and eggnog. It is packaged in individual servings within pull-top cans for convenience. According to official records, Nutraments is described as a Nutritionally Complete Food Consisting Principally of Milk Solids, Maltose-Dextrins, Soy Flour, Sucrose. In the late 1960s, a powdered version of the product was introduced, which could be mixed with milk. However, the brand registration for this powdered form was not renewed in 1988 and officially expired in 1992, although it remained under the ownership of Mead Johnson. In 1985, Mead Johnson also marketed a dietary supplement under the Nutraments brand. Later, in 1996, the company registered the brand name Nutraments The Energy and Fitness Drink. Eventually, Nutraments was acquired from Mead Johnson & Company, with the transaction becoming effective on February 13, 2004.
